text:
jamal: Need help fast 1 candidate for Sr ML Infra (A. Patel) wants $240k base. Our band top is $210k. This is outside band. Candidate has other offer, deadline Friday. Can we route an exception? :warning:
mira: This hire is blocking a dependency for the LLM runtime rollout. Candidate has LLM production caching experience. Prefer start 2026-04-15 but can be flexible by a week.
jamal: Proposed comp package:
```
base: $240,000
sign-on: $30,000 (12 months)
equity: 0.35% (4y, 1y cliff)
relocation: $10,000
start: 2026-04-15 (flex +/-1 week)
```
lucy: Thanks. Chiming in to say we need a comp justification + comp to approve >10% above band. @chris can approve up to 10% above band; >10% goes to VP People.
chris: Quick calc: band top $210k -> delta $30k = 14.3% above band. I'll need a short business justification and market data. Share any competing offer details (candidate-provided).
mira: Justification (pasteable):
- 6+ years infra + LLM runtime experience (low-latency systems).
- Direct impact on infra milestone: KV cache roll-out (Q2).
- Market comps show similar roles 8-18% above our band.
- Candidate has a written competitor offer expiring 2026-03-26.
jamal: Submitted request with justification. HR bot message below.
hr-bot: Approval request AR-2026-01921 created. Routing: chris -> sophia. Reason: MARKET_COMPETITOR. ETA: 48 hours (expedite option requested).
lucy: Can we flag as expedited due to candidate deadline? Chris, Sophia: please advise if you can short-circuit.
chris: I'm pushing to approve up to 10% now to show movement. Recommend sign-on split 50/50 at start/6mo. If VP signs for full $240k I'll finalize.
sophia (VP People): I reviewed comp packet and market signal. Approve one-time exception to base to $240k. Conditions: mark as "market hire exception", require 6-month pro-rata sign-on clawback, and attach exception code MK-HIRE-2026-03. Confirm with finance to handle sign-on schedule.
chris: Noted. I'll update comp system with MK-HIRE-2026-03 and notify payroll to split sign-on 50%/50% with 6mo clawback.
lucy: People-ops note: please include the standard onboarding packet link and set tentative start to 2026-04-15 in offer. Also cc people-ops@redwood on offer email.
jamal: Sending offer now with exception language and start date tentative. Using template: https://redwood.docs/offers/infra-template-v3.
hr-bot: Offer status: SENT. Offer AR-2026-01921 -> SENT at 15:18 PT.
jamal: Candidate accepted verbally within 2 hours and requested signed offer. I'll upload signed docs once returned.
sophia (VP People): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please ensure we record the justification and expiration of exception (12 months) in the comp system.
chris: Done. Added expiration: 2027-03-26. Exception code applied. Notifying finance via ticket FIN-7834 to schedule sign-on payout.
jamal: Uploading signed offer 16:04 PT. Requisition will be closed after paperwork.
lucy: Closing thread 1 nice work on fast routing. :tada:
